An April 2018 SD-adjacent QA commit changed Patient, StructureDefinition, StructureMap, and ValueSet source, and broader 2018 QA commits exist, but none can be tied to attachment 15609 or to this Jira key.

Jira search found sibling QA report issues for other work groups with separate attachments and statuses, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-17613 evidence.
